ABOUT US

About Gurukul

One place where every employee can discover, learn and get answers, without hunting through folders and documents.

What Gurukul is

Gurukul is the Knowledge Hub for our training content: process-wise videos, presentations, posters, SOP-based learning and the latest process updates, all in one searchable library.

Why it was created

Learning content sat across several platforms with access limits, so teams could not always reach the latest version when they needed it. Gurukul keeps one standard version, available any time, across PAN India.

How to use it

Open Assets and pick your process, search for a topic, or simply ask Guru. Videos, presentations and posters open right here on the page.

What you will find

Training videos, presentations, posters, SOPs and process documents, plus PCR updates and the newest releases, organised the same way as our content library.

How Guru helps

Guru answers process questions from the latest SOPs, finds the right video or presentation, takes you to the right section, and talks with you in English, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Tamil or Malayalam.
